plainText:
Wani-Wani (Japanese: ワニワニ Wani-Wani) is a that owns and her first partner Pokémon.

==History==
 ]]
===Pre-series===
Wani-Wani was obtained as a Totodile from Professor Elm on the same day that Vincent received his and received his , as seen in the Japanese opening and ending theme "A New Oath".

===The Legend of Thunder!===
Marina used Wani-Wani to battle Jimmy's after was defeated. Jimmy then called Beedrill back and used his Typhlosion to battle the Pokémon. During the battle, Marina was revealed to be in sync with Wani-Wani's actions. Despite the type disadvantage, Typhlosion managed to stand up to Wani-Wani's attacks.

However, the battle ended without a winner being declared because Marina and Jimmy ended up seeing from a distance the change in climate caused by Team Rocket's attack on . Shortly afterwards, Wani-Wani was returned to its .

=== ===
Wani-Wani made a cameo appearance along with its Trainer in the beginning of Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea, where Marina and her Pokémon were seen running in a plain as a appeared next to them.

=== ===
Wani-Wani was revealed to have evolved into a Feraligatr during an Internet broadcast of a Pokémon Contest in A Stand-Up Sit-Down!. It was used alongside Pink in a Double Performance, during which it used to lift Pink in the air so the Balloon Pokémon could use its attack to splash the water.
 

==Personality and characteristics==
Despite Wani-Wani's brief appearance in The Legend of Thunder!, it was shown to be in sync with its Trainer and was able to hold its own during battle. After it evolved sometime before A Stand-Up Sit-Down!, Wani-Wani was also shown to have good performing skills as Marina was able to earn the title of Top Coordinator.

==Moves used==
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
The nickname Wani-Wani either comes from ワニノコ Waninoko, 's Japanese name, or just from the Japanese word for , 鰐 wani. 
It is the only first partner Pokémon from The Legend of Thunder! that wasn't in its final form in its introduction, as Jimmy's Typhlosion and Vincent's Meganium are.
